header: Where shops help each other with their tills
lead: Four places, each at its own pace. Most answers are already in the forum, and the rest come up at the monthly meet-up.
note: Member counts are rounded and checked twice a year, so treat them as rough numbers.

places.title: User forum
places.description: About 1,400 shops. You can read without an account, and most questions already have an answer.

places.title: Kassenstammtisch Linz
places.description: First Wednesday of the month at 7pm, in a different pub each time. No signup needed, just come along.

places.title: API mailing list
places.description: About 120 subscribers and one or two emails a month, for anyone connecting their own software.

places.title: API client source code
places.description: The PHP and Python clients are public. Please report bugs instead of building workarounds.
